sentences.en: While Aveeno has an entire line of facial, acne and haircare products, the bath and body line is by far the most well known.

sentences.en: Customers begin to see results after the first use of this product, as well as many of the other haircare items found in the Jan Marini line.

sentences.en: But by rethinking our approach to haircare, we can keep looking younger for longer.
